header.subtitle: A short story about my background, experience and passions.

about.heading: Hello World!
about.content:
I'm Sebastián Soraire, Information Systems Engineer and Systems Analyst, specialized in the JavaScript ecosystem: React, React Native, Node.js, Next.js and TypeScript. Beyond the titles, I'm deeply curious and passionate about technology and how it can improve people's lives using Engineering.
I've been working in IT for more than six years. Since I was a kid, I loved building things; today I find in development and engineering that same creative spirit, amplified by the ability to generate real impact.
For the last three years I’ve been part of an Argentinian fintech, where I grew both technically and personally. My leaders have highlighted my empathy, commitment and proactivity, values I bring to every project.
I earned my degree in Information Systems Engineering from UTN and keep learning continuously. I’m also improving my English in pursuit of excellence.
I’m passionate about designing complete solutions: from understanding the problem and proposing the right architecture, to implementing, testing, and iterating under agile methodologies (SCRUM) with user feedback.
In recent years, I’ve worked on my soft skills – leadership, communication and teamwork. Learned about neuroscience and psychology, that helped me understand how emotions, awareness and empathy enhance collective performance.
Today I seek new challenges where I can merge my two main drives: technology and the human factor.

jobs.company: Diplomatura en Inteligencia Artificial Aplicada · UTN – Facultad Regional Tucumán · Online / On-site
details: Designed and delivered content on AI Fundamentals & Evaluation, training professionals in no-code Machine Learning, ethical data governance and managerial auditing of metrics, vendors and technology solutions.

Led advanced training in Generative AI and custom assistants: hands-on Prompt Engineering (CRAFT framework) and the design and deployment of specialized persistent assistants (GPTs, Gems, Claude Projects, NotebookLM) for knowledge management.

Taught intelligent automation and organizational adoption to professionals from diverse industries, covering RAG architecture, autonomous AI agents, automation workflows and change-management strategies for enterprise AI risk governance.
Take part in requirements gathering and analysis with the team, translating business needs into technical solutions.
Collaborate on architecture design and data modeling, prioritizing scalable and maintainable solutions.
Develop and maintain frontend and backend features applying best practices, clean code and design patterns.
Integrate APIs and third-party services, ensuring reliable communication between system components.
Perform code reviews and pull request reviews to keep code quality and consistency.
Contribute to testing, technical documentation and deployment of the solutions.
Work collaboratively under agile methodologies, taking part in team planning, dailies and retrospectives.

Architected and delivered production-ready web and mobile applications, improving feature scalability and maintainability by implementing modular frontend architectures with React, Next.js and React Native.
Reduced development and iteration cycles, measured by faster prototype-to-production delivery, by integrating REST APIs, reusable component systems and clean architecture patterns.

Improved code quality and development efficiency, measured by more stable releases and faster feature implementation, by applying code reviews, testing practices and modern software engineering standards.
Led product discovery and feature planning, aligning development with business objectives and user needs, by facilitating brainstorming sessions and translating requirements into technical solutions.
Managed client relationships and technical negotiations, ensuring delivery alignment and project continuity by acting as primary point of contact for stakeholders.
Oversaw deployment and production environments, improving application reliability by implementing CI/CD pipelines, observability practices and performance optimization.
Collaborated on product positioning and growth strategy, translating technical capabilities into marketable value propositions for SaaS and analytics platforms.
Implemented the debit card management module, automating activation and operations directly from the app, improving user experience.
Contributed to the full redesign of the company’s web and mobile wallet, modernizing legacy code and applying best practices in React Native and React JS.

These improvements and technical debt refactors significantly enhanced user experience, making the applications faster, smoother, more stable, and visually engaging, with fewer errors and a clearer, more intuitive navigation.

Worked closely with the UX Design team using Figma to implement interface and experience improvements, and collaborated with backend developers through code reviews and pull request validation to ensure code quality and consistency.
Collaborated with the team to develop solutions for the Security and Compliance department, automating processes and reducing review and approval times by 40%.
Leveraged AI to automate repetitive coding tasks, cutting development time by half and increasing efficiency and product quality.
Promoted a collaborative and empathetic work environment, encouraging open communication, cooperation, and continuous improvement within the team.
Built a QR code generation and scanning system for package tracking, reducing management times by 70% and eliminating manual errors.
Developed a platform using Google Maps API to monitor routes and deliveries in real time, improving timing and optimization of shipments and tracking.
Implemented a staff attendance control system that automated the calculation of schedules, attendance, and absences, improving administrative management by over 60%.
Applied the SCRUM methodology throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring proper planning, control, and continuous improvement in projects.
Provided technical support for Internet, TV, and telephony services.
Developed assertive communication, empathy, and effective problem-solving skills under pressure.
Achieved high levels of customer satisfaction and consistently met performance metrics.

ecommerce.title: Online Store
ecommerce.shortDescription: Integral platform for product management, sales, and online catalog.
ecommerce.details: System composed of an Online Store and a Commercial Management System (SGC). Allows managing a detailed catalog with retail, wholesale, and promotional prices, handling the status of each product. The SGC facilitates sales registration with automatic total calculation and allows applying manual discounts, either by item or on the total operation, being registered in the history. The purchase price is reserved for internal use, ensuring the privacy of costs in front of the final customer. It also includes tools for employee management.

pwa.title: Progressive Web App
pwa.shortDescription: MVP for testing push notifications and notification segmentation
pwa.details: This PWA functions as an MVP designed to improve retention and conversion through direct push notifications. The system allows segmenting users based on their preferences or behavior, achieving more relevant and personalized communications. As a progressive web application, it offers an experience similar to a native app, enabling quick installation on mobile devices without going through stores, facilitating constant access to promotions and commercial news in an efficient and scalable manner.

24Studio.title: 24 Studio
24Studio.details: The upcoming launch and deployment phase of 24Studio, a next-generation Software Factory engineered for high-impact digital solutions. Currently in pre-operational status, the platform establishes a robust production framework that bridges the gap between initial business briefs and scalable architecture. We are finalizing our core technology stack, integrating automated Hardening protocols, and standardized Staging environments to ensure seamless delivery. 24Studio is set to begin operations soon.

teamsImprove.title: Team's Improve
teamsImprove.shortDescription: Platform for team and user performance management and analysis
teamsImprove.details: A modern platform for managing, analyzing, and enhancing team and user performance with interactive dashboards and real-time metrics.

speak.title: Listen & Speak
speak.shortDescription: Interactive pronunciation coach for language learners of all ages
speak.details: Interactive web platform that allows users to listen to alphabet letter pronunciations, example words for each letter, and custom texts. Includes preloaded common words and a feature for users to input any text and hear its correct pronunciation in real-time in English or Spanish.

complianceAutomation.title: Compliance Automation Engine
complianceAutomation.shortDescription: Centralized automation platform for security and compliance
complianceAutomation.details: I participated in developing a centralized platform for the Security and Compliance department. The solution automated critical manual workflows, including policy exception reviews, access certification campaigns, and audit evidence collection. By digitizing and streamlining these processes, we slashed average review and approval cycle times by 40%, significantly reducing operational risk and ensuring a more agile and demonstrable compliance posture.

Web Wallet
productModernizationweb.shortDescription: Launching a New Design and Core Functionalities
productModernizationweb.details: Contributed to the complete redesign of the company’s web wallet, modernizing legacy code and applying best practices in React JS. These improvements and technical-debt refactors significantly enhanced the user experience, resulting in a faster, more stable, visually appealing platform with fewer errors and a clearer, more intuitive navigation flow.

productModernizationapp.title:
Update Codebase & Feature Additions 
App Wallet
productModernizationapp.shortDescription: Launching a New Design and Core Functionalities
productModernizationapp.details: Contributed to the modernization of a mobile app by improving performance, stabilizing core flows, and enhancing UI/UX. Collaborated on integrating 10+ REST APIs, building reusable UI components, and refactoring legacy logic with stronger error handling. Played a key role in implementing offline-first features and optimizing state management, which helped reduce crashes and improve rendering performance by ~30%. Through team effort, delivered a smoother, faster, and more reliable user experience across devices.

prepaidCard.title: Prepaid Cards Module
prepaidCard.shortDescription: Prepaid card self-management in mobile application
prepaidCard.details: Led the update, development and implementation of the Module Prepaid Card for self-service debit card management within the mobile application. This feature enabled users to instantly activate new cards and perform key operations such as temporary locks, unlocks, and status checks entirely through the app. By eliminating the need for customer service calls or branch visits, the module fully automated the management workflow, achieving a dramatic improvement in user experience and a significant reduction in operational costs.

map.title: Real-Time Tracked
map.shortDescription: Following in real-time the routes and deliveries of a logistics company
map.details: Spearheaded the development a logistics monitoring solution powered by the Google Maps API. The system enabled real-time tracking of delivery fleets, providing live updates on vehicle location, route progress, and delivery status. This end-to-end visibility facilitated dynamic route optimization, reduced travel times, and offered customers precise tracking, leading to a substantial improvement in shipment timeliness and overall operational efficiency.

qr.title: QR Tracked
qr.shortDescription: QR code-based package tracking and management system
qr.details: Designed and implemented the 'ScanFlow' system, a comprehensive package management platform utilizing QR code technology. The solution featured the generation of unique QR code labels for each shipment and their scanning at every checkpoints (receiving, in-transit, delivery). This end-to-end automation of the package lifecycle completely eliminated manual data entry errors and slashed management and tracking query times by 70%, revolutionizing the logistics operation.

automated.title: Automated Time Management
automated.shortDescription: Comprehensive automation of biometric attendance and payroll
automated.details:
Implemented a comprehensive staff attendance and payroll control system that, using biometric data from a fingerprint scanner, fully automates workforce management.
 The system processes the data to evaluate in real-time punctuality, attendance, overtime, productivity bonuses, and absence deductions. As a final output, it automatically generates detailed reports of days worked and the precise calculation of payroll dues, eliminating manual errors and improving administrative efficiency by over 60%.

frontend.javascript: The fundamental language of modern web development. Enables interactive experiences in the browser and connects logic with design.
frontend.typescript: A superset of JavaScript that adds static typing and advanced tooling. Improves scalability, readability and maintainability in large projects.
frontend.react1: A declarative library by Meta to build dynamic, reusable UIs for the web. Great for SPAs with high performance through an efficient Virtual DOM.
frontend.react2: A framework based on React JS to build native mobile apps with JavaScript and React. Compiles to native components for high performance and a near-native experience.
frontend.next: A React framework that enables SSR and SSG. Optimizes SEO and speeds up page loads.
frontend.html: Markup language that defines the base structure of any website. Foundation for content, accessibility and document semantics.

backend.nodejs: JavaScript runtime for the server side. Great for fast, scalable apps thanks to its asynchronous, event-driven model.
backend.c-sharp: Modern, strongly-typed OOP language by Microsoft. Ideal for enterprise apps, APIs and .NET development.
backend.python: Versatile, expressive language with simple syntax. Widely used in backend, data analysis, AI and automation.
backend.php: Mature, reliable language for dynamic web apps. Popular in LAMP stacks and CMSs such as WordPress or Laravel.

database.sqlServer: Robust Microsoft solution for database management. High performance, security and built-in analytics tools.
database.postgress: Advanced open-source relational database. Supports complex queries, transactional integrity and powerful extensions.
database.git: Distributed version control to manage code changes, collaborate and keep full development history.
database.vite: Ultra-fast dev tool replacing traditional bundlers. Instant HMR and efficient builds for modern frontend projects.
